targets.note: The Files place over the Northwind sample Space: the tree (Recent, Shared with me, Trash, the folders in Personal, Shared with me and Space, Knowledge) and the Sales folder as one list of ui/Row lines. The prototype side is its Files place in the same skin. On a phone only the list shows, as in the prototype.

Two lines selected (Cmd-click): the quiet selection token on whole rows and the count in the header. The prototype shows one selected row; the multi-select count is compared with its design notes (spec 3.5).

Quick Look on a selected file (Space): the file large with its kind, size and who last changed it. The prototype opens its viewer from the same list; compare the card against its raised surface and type.
The sort menu open: Name, Date modified, Size, Kind with a checkmark, then the direction.
Shared with me: what was granted, as one list. The prototype side is its Files place.
The same Files place over the Harbor Studio sample Space.
10,000 files in one folder; the scroll probe takes the p95 frame interval over the full scroll (budget scroll, 16.7 ms).
